correctness.rationale: Writing permutations as ranks of iid continuous X gives 2-dependent local indicators. Exact overlap counts for offsets d=0,1,2 yield (n-2)V0+(n-3)(V1+V1^T)+(n-4)(V2+V2^T); the supplied integer A,B follow from all 24 and 120 local orders. Independently reconstructed exact 36-entry rational covariances by brute-force permutation enumeration n=4..7, with eigenvalues and rank five as stated, including n=4 degeneracy. The identity W=R1-R_{n-1} telescopes each triple, hence three-point law and Var=1/2. Leading A/360 has nullspace exactly total-count direction and W; four positive modes give uniqueness for fixed coefficients, bounded stationary 2-dependent CLT by Cramer--Wold. No inference from finite enumeration to arbitrary n.
